content:
arjun: Heads-up — since the ALB push ~10:20 we've seen a 30-40% uptick in slow-first-chunk for long-lived gRPC streams. Clients time out waiting for the first data chunk and then reconnect repeatedly.

marta: Ugh, saw alerts. Any pattern by region or backend pool? :eyes:

arjun: Mostly us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Not all pods, seemed concentrated on backends behind the new target-group config with connection_reuse enabled.

kai: Logs show a lot of streams stuck at 'stream open' but no DATA frames for ~3-5s, then a window update or reset from the ALB. Example from ingress-proxy: `h2: stream 123: header complete, waiting for DATA` then `envoy grpc reset`

lee: Did the ALB rollout change idle timeout or healthcheck path? ALB change PR mentioned target_group deregistration_delay tweaked.

arjun: deploy-bot: ALB config v2.4 rolled at 10:17 by infra-cfg.

marta: Could be keepalive/idle mismatch between ALB and our envoy pools causing streams to get buffered then flushed. Also seeing ephemeral port churn on NAT gateways per netstat sampling — ephemeral ports near exhaustion on some edge nodes.

kai: Repro steps I ran: curl --http2 -N to the edge then start a small gRPC stream, the HTTP/2 connection remains open but first data frame delayed. Packet captures show SYN/ACK reuse and then a tiny data burst after TCP slow-start/connection reuse handshake.

lee: That smells like ALB doing connection reuse but not forwarding early DATA due to buffering or missing WINDOW_UPDATE from downstream. If ALB delays WINDOW_UPDATE until it has some buffer available the app will stall.

arjun: Quick mitigation idea: flip ALB to not reuse connections for that target-group (connection_draining/keepalive off) and see if slow-first-chunk disappears. Also temporarily bump NAT ephemeral port range on edge nodes.

marta: Agree. Can someone try a canary change to disable conn reuse and extend target_group deregistration_delay back to previous value? I'll watch metrics.

kai: Running a small canary now on one AZ — toggled reuse off and set deregister_delay 300s.

sre-bot: Metric alert suppressed for stream-slow-first-chunk on tg-canary-1 per manual mute by marta for 30m.

lee: After canary I've already seen RTT for first chunk drop from 1.8s -> 120ms on that AZ.

arjun: Great. If that holds, we should rollout revert of the connection_reuse bits and open a ticket with ALB support about H2 WINDOW_UPDATE/flow control behavior. Also schedule a NAT port range increase and add monitoring for ephemeral_port_utilization.

marta: Filing ticket and postmortem template. Notes: possible causes = ALB H2 buffering + target-group conn reuse; NAT ephemeral port exhaustion exacerbating reconnects; TCP slow-start interaction on reuse.

kai: Also worth testing envoy initial_window_size and our HTTP/2 SETTINGS handling; might get better if we tune smaller bursts from clients.

lee: I'll coordinate the NAT patch and rollback. Keep the canary running 30m and ping me if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

arjun: Thanks — will follow up with logs and a small pcap sample in the ticket.
